generator_lock.context_policy: Retrieved complete metric row, all available year/value pairs, normalized signs, source entity and unit. If no verified candidate, use the first two retrieved snippets.
generator_lock.selection_policy: One predeclared model/prompt; run dev before test. No tuning on test outputs. The test set has been inspected previously; this is a reused benchmark, not fresh independent validation.

scope: numeric and unanswerable only; row-assisted amount generation
timing: CPU, four threads; candidate reader and generation; cached retrieval excluded
test_reuse: Previously inspected test split; exploratory, not independent validation
